title: jev in chats and saved runs: renderers and saved.js mapping
what:
As pass 1.
renderers/jev.js:
- jev_choose: bars sorted by p, best marked, margin (top minus runner-up); no floor in chats
- jev_entail: scores per hypothesis
- jev_mark: one line
- exports ProbBars({rows, floor?, margin?, pick?})
Register them in renderers/index.js.
core/saved.js maps:
- WorkflowStart -> an x-line
- WorkflowStep -> tool-call-started {id: call_id, name: tool, input parsed once more, origin: script}
- ToolResult paired by tool_use_id
- a park's AskUser -> an ask row with its answer
- WorkflowEnd -> an x-line
tests:
saved.test.mjs over F0 cases a-h:
- no 'not shown here' line for any Workflow* record
- no tool row named '?'
- every jev_choose paired
It fails if saved.js is reverted. probbars.test.mjs checks ordering and argmax first-of-equals.
live_check: fake perch on PORT=48124: an F0 fixture copied in as a saved chat shows bars, mark lines and the answered park.
